purpose: Join write-before-launch intent, process identity and verified cleanup with a durable journal, without falsely labelling inclusive intervals as atomic ATPG runtime
prior_ledger_semantics_unchanged: ATOMIC_ATPG_PROCESS_ONLY and its historical lower-bound aggregate are not silently changed by v2

linux_reference.role: Reference for group-cleanup boundary only; no retrospective journal events or timestamps are invented

cost_semantics.end: After verified cleanup, before terminal append/flush/fsync acknowledgment
cost_semantics.unit: integer nanosecond units; synthetic fixture time is not measured wall runtime
cost_semantics.complete_live_sum_requires: Every intended attempt has acknowledged identity, verified cleanup and acknowledged terminal event in this live writer
cost_semantics.any_uncertainty: Whole usable sum is null; never zero-fill, drop failed attempts or publish a partial lower bound as complete
cost_semantics.replay_limit: Complete canonical bytes and hash chain do not prove original fsync acknowledgment or process execution. Replay alone cannot release usable cost labels.

lifecycle.unknown_spawn: Incomplete, block all later attempts; absence is not inferred from an exception
lifecycle.post_launch_exceptions: Known-handle cleanup on Exception and BaseException; cancellation is not transformed into success
lifecycle.journal_error: Stop and preserve original bytes; no reopen-to-append, truncate or repair

evidence_and_permissions.backend: Synthetic in-process fault fixture only, no arbitrary command or production adapter

validation: all three terminal outcomes recorded and included
unknown spawn does not become absence or zero cost
identity acknowledgment failure still cleans known handle
cleanup failure or residual group blocks the phase
terminal acknowledgment failure suppresses complete usable sum
short write, flush or fsync uncertainty poisons writer
tampered, partial, duplicate, reordered or wrong-clock replay rejected
byte-complete replay cannot authenticate fsync acknowledgment
